Make your bed and plan your day before you check your phone. Two small wins before anything else trains your brain to choose effort over comfort.
Keep a reading list and a done list. Every book you finish goes on the done list. Watching it grow is one of the best motivators for a disciplined mind.
Learn the history of the place you live. Its wars, its builders, its old streets. Knowing where you come from makes you sharper and more grounded.
Train at the same time every day. Not when you feel like it, at your fixed slot. Discipline is built by removing the daily decision to start.
Make learning automatic. I do five minutes a day of history, art or science, at the same time every day, and it became as natural as brushing my teeth.
slides.texte_sophia: I do five minutes a day on a micro-learning app like the Sophia app, at the same time every day. History, art, science. It's now as natural as brushing my teeth.

slides.texte_overlay: Write a one-page summary of every book you read. Writing forces you to understand, and those pages become your own personal library of ideas.
Go to bed early on purpose. Disciplined mornings start the night before. A strong evening routine is the hidden secret behind every focused man.
